readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order (one caption per panel, then the 03-5 label) matches the script exactly. Their concerns: (1) From the placeholders alone, it is not clear who is the patient and who works at the desk in 03-1. The art resolves it: Meera, in her blue kurta with her braid, types behind the desk, and Mr. Raman stands at the counter with his cane. (2) Slot ownership in 03-5 is unclear. The left-to-right seating matches the check-in order, and 04-1 confirms Ravi = A-12 ('NOW · A-12', the other two seats empty). Acceptable. (3) 'Some check in ahead' leaves its subject implied. It reads naturally after 03-1's 'patients', and it is the source's wording. They also noted that captions do not overlap placeholders. With the raised 03-2 box that is still true (19 px clear of the priya box). The revision moved only the 03-2 caption, and that move reveals Priya's scrunchie and ponytail. Nothing is unresolved.
